meta.title: FISTASHION — Premium Bakery & Café
meta.description: More than a bakery. Carefully crafted pastry, specialty coffee, refined interiors and warm Saudi hospitality in Medina.

manifesto.title: More than a bakery.
manifesto.lead: FISTASHION is created around the idea that every morning deserves something memorable. We combine carefully crafted bakery products, specialty coffee, refined interiors and warm Saudi hospitality to create an experience guests want to remember — and share.

signature.title: A signature of Fistashion.
signature.lead: Pistachio appears here as a fine detail: verdant, rich and unmistakable. A considered expression of our craft — never the whole story.

craft.coffeeLead: Espresso · Americano · Cappuccino · Flat White · Latte · Iced Coffee · Signature Coffee
craft.breakfastLead: French Toast · Avocado & Poached Egg Toast · Truffle Scrambled Croissant · Signature breakfast dishes
craft.bakeLead: Croissants, pain au chocolat, Danish pastries, brioche, artisan bread and seasonal laminated pastries — made to pause for.
craft.dessertLead: Elegant finishes, complex textures and the quiet pleasure of a perfectly made dessert.

space.title: Come for the coffee. Stay for the experience.
space.lead: Dark green, warm light, natural stone and quiet details — a contemporary Saudi meeting place.

green.title: Dark Green
green.desc: Deep forest tones offering a cool, quiet sanctuary from the Medina sun.

light.title: Warm Light
light.desc: Soft amber radiance that shifts gently from dawn espresso to late evening.

stone.title: Natural Stone
stone.desc: Honed marble surfaces, cool to the touch and grounded in quiet luxury.

details.title: Quiet Details
details.desc: Brushed brass accents, fine porcelain, and the warmth of Saudi hospitality.

visit.title: Your next morning ritual.
visit.lead: Al Jamiah, Madinah — first line beside the Islamic University.

story.title: Your morning, your story.
story.lead: Share the coffee, the table and the small moments that make the morning yours.
